status: Prospective source/value gate before any new endpoint values; retrospective source decisions already read and reused
ownership: Only this owned subtree; root alone main/shared integration/push
question: Do existing public native-EMC systemic-treatment records permit a useful individual-level contrast between radiographic progression/death and cessation or conversion to local treatment, using a shared treatment-start origin and all public conditions, beyond already reported response/PFS summaries?
clinical_use: If authenticated event types and trajectories exist, determine what durable control actually measures and whether a distinct intercurrent event changes the next clinical-study endpoint; do not claim causal treatment efficacy.
prior_art: Published systemic response/PFS findings and the existing endpoint manuscript corpus already address indolence, endpoint benchmarks, line differences and quantity corrections. R7 already authenticates surgery censoring and repeated institutional cohorts; R9 already source-gates broader trials. Neither a known duration correction nor missing-data inventory is a new finding.
eligibility: Native author/pathology or molecularly supported EMC; exact case ID and all treatment conditions; no generic chondrosarcoma or fusion topology inference. Molecular identity used only as diagnostic support.
required_source_fields: treatment initiation or explicitly measured elapsed origin
intercurrent surgery or alternate-treatment/discontinuation date and reason
same-donor links across series and repeated lines
conditional_estimand: Only after useful source map and root review: cause-specific cumulative event probabilities from treatment start with progression/death event distinguished from source-defined local intervention or cessation; no treating surgery as random censoring by default and no attributing benefits causally. Exact estimand/horizon/model must receive a new immutable analysis freeze before values.
comparators: Within the same authenticated cohort and prospective assay/time origin, all source conditions. Published aggregate cross-drug PFS medians and unlinked lines are not comparable controls.
strongest_alternatives: Indolent baseline natural history and treatment selection
Line, baseline progression requirement and prior local therapy differences
Informative surgery/discontinuation and variable assessment frequency
Death missing or conflated with progression; publication-biased individual histories
Repeated referral patients or serial lines counted as independent donors
defeat_or_stop: No linked individual event types and common origin
Only published isolated response/duration narratives or aggregate survival summaries
Contrast is already reported or merely corrects our prior unpublished record
Missing suitable public conditions or unresolved identity/overlap prevents a useful estimate
methods_before_outcomes: Read cached primary methods, table headers, row IDs/diagnoses, published data availability and schema only. Do not project new PFS/response/death/duration cells or plot values; no image digitization. Existing verified findings explicitly reused. No numerical stage authorized.
source_universe_initial: R7 clinical linkage all evaluated treatment sources and unavailable tables
R6 Morioka/Mizusawa and palliative timing decisions
R9 broader trial original JATS and supplement schemas
Existing endpoint primary audit/corpus for prior value coverage
